description: Step 2. Creates the order from get_quote's next.arguments (quoteId, plus to if the quote had none): one order per quote; moves no funds. An order cannot be cancelled; unfunded, it expires. Retry with the same arguments: the default idempotencyKey returns the same order. Fund once, only while payable is true: before signing deposit.payment, get_swap_status {orderId, payment} must return paymentCheck.safeToSend. Next: get_swap_status.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; default q_<quoteId>. Reuse on every retry. A custom key: a fresh random UUID per intent.

quoteIntentDigest.description: From next.arguments: create fails if the quote's terms differ.

to.description: Destination, only if the quote had none (next.missing). Never guess.
